text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Sophisticated layered cut-paper environment of an empty undersea shell-shaped open-air theatre, scalloped ivory paper proscenium and coral-orange tiered seats, peacock-teal seaweed shapes and deep blue layered ocean depth, precise cut edges and delicate cast shadows reveal paper craft, frontal immersive composition, no performers or animals.
